raw_page_capture.layout: layer, K then V, token, row bytes

scope.bytes: Gross modeled representation bytes including metadata. Fragment and cap skips are recorded separately.
scope.codec: Shadow raw/reference/patch representations of stored source pages. Real LMCache consumes raw objects.
scope.demand: A completed matching native lookup establishes observed demand. An absent receipt does not prove a page was never reused.
scope.retention: Base presence is observed at write or verified lookup instants. Pin lifetimes and net occupancy are unmodeled.
scope.sample: Complete P-native 16-token pages whose full K/V rows are observed across layers.
scope.transfer: NIXL behavior is unchanged. Shifted restores prove stored source bytes before Blend repair.
